title: Qualifying both selectors resolves the ambiguity
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
ns a http://a.com
ns b http://b.com
---
{ aStatus: payload.root.a#Status, bStatus: payload.root.b#Status }

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
ns a http://a.com
ns b http://b.com
---
{ aStatus: payload.root.a#Status, bStatus: payload.root.b#Status }

explanation.approach: Once each selector names both the prefix and the local name, each one reaches exactly the element it means.
